script: Sharks have been around longer than trees. The first sharks appeared more than 400 million years ago. The first trees appeared tens of millions of years later. Sharks have survived at least four mass extinctions, including the one that wiped out the dinosaurs. Their skeletons are made of cartilage, the same flexible material as your nose and ears.
